title: SA-02m unified device model (sh-model)
description: Machine artefact for docs/contracts/sh-model.md. Device -> functions[] -> points[]. quality is REQUIRED on every Point and has no default (fail-closed: an absent/unknown quality is read as bad/uncertain by the consumer, never good). additionalProperties:false everywhere (an unknown field is an error, never silently accepted). English only (PROTOCOL.md invariant 5).

id.description: MQTT device id, the /devices/<id>/ segment (docs/MQTT_TOPICS.md schema). A roster row's identity (docs/contracts/rs485-roster.md).

model.description: Module model as the roster reports it (rs485-roster.md ours[].model), or the catalog model for a third-party template device.

address.description: Modbus slave address on the RS-485 line.

online.description: From the roster; null when the source cannot tell (scan source, rs485-roster.md).

source.description: Provenance of the roster row (rs485-roster.md): bridge = live poll, scan = last flasher scan.

setup.description: Holding-register init writes applied on start (adapts Spruthub options[] / template-device.md device.setup). Trusted input from the model file itself, never from a request.

name.description: Human label of the option (documentation only).

endpoint.description: Widget instance index within the device (adapts Spruthub services[].endpoint).

composition.description: true marks a SEMANTIC grouping over Point-roles that already exist on the wire (Pump/Valve/Drive/Alarm), not a distinct driver. Honesty: a composed type must be marked so it is not passed off as its own device.

virtual.description: true marks a computed/group device with no direct wire binding; its points MAY omit binding (their value is derived from other points). A physical Function's points MUST carry binding (enforced below).

then.description: A non-virtual (physical) Function requires binding on every point.

layout.description: Widget placement (adapts Spruthub HSQLDB Services gridOrder/Width/Height).

functionType.description: The v1 (WIDE) Function-type set. Every value is grounded in a real WB module, a live SA-02m control, or the HomeKit/Spruthub service catalog (docs/contracts/sh-model.md 4.2).

id.description: Point identity, unique within its Function (typically the WB control name, docs/MQTT_TOPICS.md).

unit.description: Engineering unit (WB units, docs/MQTT_TOPICS.md; e.g. V, A, W, degC, %).

ts.description: Unix seconds of the last value update.

role.description: What the point DOES (orthogonal to valueType).

valueType.description: Value type on the wire (grounded on Spruthub common.js bool/int/float/stringValue and WB formats).

quality.description: COMPUTED value fitness (docs/contracts/sh-model.md 4.4). Normalised on the model layer from existing wire signals (meta/error + device-offline + ts freshness); nothing new is added on the MQTT bus. REQUIRED, no default.

binding.description: Tagged union: a point is bound to a Modbus register OR an MQTT topic. Discriminated by kind.

bindingModbus.description: Adapts the Spruthub link[] entry (address/function/pollingTime/valueType) and KEEPS the SA-02m rich fields template-device.md channels[] carries (scale/offset/word_order/units).

function.description: Modbus object type (Spruthub link.function; reconciles to template-device.md reg_type coil/discrete/holding/input).

valueType.description: Wire format (Spruthub link.valueType; reconciles to template-device.md format).

pollingTime.description: Poll cadence in MILLISECONDS, per channel (Spruthub link.pollingTime). template-device.md poll_s is SECONDS, per device: a granularity difference reconciled in sh-model.md 4.5.

scale.description: value = raw*scale+offset (SA-02m rich field; not in Spruthub link).

word_order.description: 32-bit word order (SA-02m rich field; not in Spruthub link).

bindingMqtt.description: Binding to a live WB-MQTT control (the model built from the running bus, not directly from Modbus).

writeTopic.description: Command topic /devices/<id>/controls/<name>/on for a command/setpoint point. The write path itself is docs/contracts/mqtt-set-endpoint.md (auth->CSRF->allow-list->publish, no retain) - referenced, never re-specified here.

retained.description: Whether the state topic is retained (WB convention: /controls/* are retained).
